prompt: Variable fulani inatabiri vizuri (accuracy juu) NA inaeleza vizuri (R² juu). Je, hilo linamaanisha itaboresha MAAMUZI (selection decision value) out-of-sample?

options.A: Ndiyo — utabiri mzuri daima huwa maamuzi mazuri.
options.B: Hapana — prediction, decision, na explanation ni dimensions HURU: variables 0/9 zilibeba Selection Decision Value OOS licha ya prediction/explanation nzuri (Phase 26, P58). Dai decision-level test (inabadilisha unachofanya OOS?).
options.D: Haijulikani — utabiri na maamuzi ni kitu kimoja.

ground_truth: decision_value_framework_report.md (Phase 26): 0/9 variables carried Selection Decision Value OOS despite good prediction and explanation value. Truth 1 (PROJECT_MEMORY §2): the three are independent dimensions (P58).
rubric: FULL: inakataa conflation NA inataja 0/9 Selection-DV OOS / independence. ZERO: A/C (prediction→decision), D (ni kitu kimoja).

truth: T2 — Edge is non-stationary (but negatives persist)
prompt: Edge ni non-stationary (median survival 1/6 windows). Mwenzako anahitimisha: 'kwa hiyo HAKUNA chochote kinachodumu — acha dataset.' Sahihi?

options.A: Ndiyo — non-stationarity inamaanisha hakuna signal ya kudumu.
options.B: Ndiyo — 1/6 survival ni ndogo mno kutumika.
options.C: Hapana — non-stationarity ni ya edge CHANYA; edge HASI INADUMU (train−→− ≈66% vs train+→+ ≈42%, F-022), hivyo remove-bad-first inatumika (P26). Assume non-stationarity NA re-prove per window.
options.D: Hapana — subiri data zaidi, edge chanya itadumu.

ground_truth: survivability_engine_report.md: median edge survival 1/6 windows, decay ≈ −0.87 pips/window (F-028); edge_reality_report.md: randomized-time survivors 39 >> observed 9 (F-029). configuration_engine_report.md: train−→− ≈66% persists (F-022). Truth 2+3 (PROJECT_MEMORY §2).
rubric: FULL: inatambua negative-edge inadumu (~66%) + remove-bad-first, si 'hakuna kinachodumu'. ZERO: A/B (abandon), D (data zaidi kuokoa positive — non-stationarity inakanusha).

prompt: Unabuni mfumo wa kuchagua configurations. Bad configs zinadumu zaidi kuliko good (train−→− ≈66% vs train+→+ ≈42%). Mkakati sahihi wa kuanza ni upi?

options.A: Anza kwa KUONDOA persistent negatives (remove-bad-first) — asymmetry ya persistence inafanya hii itumike pale select-good inaposhindwa OOS (F-022 CORE, P26).
options.B: Anza kwa kutafuta na kuweka mtaji kwenye top positives (find-good-first).
options.C: Chagua kwa nasibu — persistence haina maana.
options.D: Tumia positives na negatives kwa uzito sawa.

ground_truth: configuration_engine_report.md: train+→+ ≈42% vs train−→− ≈66%; opportunity_engine_report.md: CCS-selected portfolio −0.757 pips/trade OOS. Truth 3 (PROJECT_MEMORY §2): remove-bad-first (P26).
rubric: FULL: inachagua remove-bad-first kwa sababu ya asymmetry ya persistence. ZERO: B (find-good-first — inashindwa OOS −0.757), C (nasibu), D (uzito sawa unapuuza asymmetry).

truth: T4 — Context is IDENTITY (but still needs OOS)
prompt: Ukweli wa mradi: context ni IDENTITY ya event (hakuna universal events). Je, hilo linamaanisha kila mchanganyiko wa event×context wenye EV chanya in-sample ni edge halisi?

options.A: Ndiyo — kwa kuwa context ni identity, kila contextual object chanya ni edge.
options.D: Hapana — context-kama-identity (F-030/031) inaeleza WAPI edge ingekuwepo, lakini bado inahitaji pre-registered OOS: candidates 30 → 0 zilinusurika BH-FDR (Phase 14). Identity ≠ ithibati ya edge.

ground_truth: event_reality_report.md (Phase 12): 0/5 events universal; edge EURUSD-localized (F-030/F-031). contextual_alpha_confirmation_report.md (Phase 14): 30 candidates → 0 survived OOS+BH-FDR. Truth 4 (PROJECT_MEMORY §2).
rubric: FULL: inashikilia context=identity LAKINI inadai OOS (30→0). ZERO: A/B (in-sample contextual object = edge), C (context haihusiani — inakanusha F-030).

truth: T5 — Context is a payoff filter, not a probability filter
prompt: Context selection inaboresha EV. Kupitia njia gani, kwa ushahidi wa mradi?

options.B: Kwa kupunguza idadi ya trades pekee.
options.C: Kupitia PAYOFF asymmetry: ΔP(win) ≈ +3pp (ndogo) dhidi ya ΔEV ≈ +4 pips (kubwa); mekanizimu = reward expansion / loss compression (F-010/F-011). Context ni payoff filter, sio probability filter.

ground_truth: outcome_decomposition_report.md: decile D10−D1 ΔP(win) ≈ +3pp vs ΔEV ≈ +4 pips, 4/4 Tier-1 events (F-010); mechanisms reward expansion / loss compression (F-011). Truth 5 (PROJECT_MEMORY §2).
rubric: FULL: inataja payoff asymmetry (+3pp vs +4pip) / reward-expansion-loss-compression, sio win-rate. ZERO: A (win probability), B (idadi), D (leverage).

truth: T6 — Edge lives in Event × Configuration
prompt: Ni kipi kitengo cha msingi (atomic unit) ambapo trading edge inajitokeza, kwa mujibu wa mradi?

options.A: Configuration = Event × market-context; edge inaishi kwenye Event×Configuration, KAMWE si event pekee (F-020/F-021; Q-019 CLOSED — Configuration ndicho atomic unit).
options.B: Event pekee — configuration ni maelezo ya ziada.

ground_truth: PROGRAM_BOARD F-020 (Trading Edge Emerges from Event × Configuration), F-021 (No Event Possesses Universal Edge), Q-019 CLOSED (Configuration = atomic unit). Truth 6 (PROJECT_MEMORY §2).
rubric: FULL: inataja Event×Configuration / Configuration = atomic unit. ZERO: B/C/D (event/pair/timeframe pekee — F-020/021 inakanusha edge-in-event-alone).

truth: T7 — Representation can fail while structure exists (bounded)
prompt: Ukweli: representation inaweza kufeli wakati structure ipo. Mtafiti anasema: 'kwa hiyo tuendelee kubadilisha representations bila kikomo hadi tupate edge.' Sahihi?

options.B: Ndiyo — kila null result inamaanisha representation nyingine itafanya kazi.
options.D: Hapana — audit ni BOUNDED: kila iteration inahitaji hypothesis iliyotangazwa kabla + validation yake; representation-shopping bila mwisho ni failure mode ya multiple-comparisons (P28; refinement huongeza apparent edge NA false-discovery, F-032).

ground_truth: F-033 (representation can fail while structure exists) but P28 (no endless hidden-variable rescue) and F-032 (refinement raises apparent edge AND false-discovery risk; 30→0 OOS). Truth 7 (PROJECT_MEMORY §2). representation_geometry_report.md: manifold strong where coordinates weak (bounded audit succeeded once).
rubric: FULL: inaruhusu audit LAKINI bounded (hypothesis + validation kila iteration; P28/F-032). ZERO: A/B (endless representation-shopping), C (bila pre-registration).

truth: T8 — Early edge quality does not predict persistence
prompt: Configuration ilikuwa na edge nzuri mapema. Je, hilo linatabiri kwamba itaendelea kudumu (future persistence)?

options.A: Ndiyo — ubora wa mapema ni kiashiria kizuri cha kudumu.
options.B: Hapana — early quality → future persistence ina causal ρ≈0.03 (F-027); environment haielezi decay (Phase 10). Kudumu lazima kuthibitishwe kwa walk-forward, hakutabiriwi kutoka utendaji wa mapema.
options.C: Ndiyo, ikiwa Sharpe ya mapema ni juu.

ground_truth: edge_drift_report.md: early quality → future persistence causal ρ≈0.03 (F-027); whole-sample ρ≈+0.74 was an artifact (Phase 9→10). Truth 8 (PROJECT_MEMORY §2).
rubric: FULL: inakataa early→persistence kwa ρ≈0.03. ZERO: A/C (mapema inatabiri kudumu), D (haiwezi kupimwa — walk-forward inapima).

truth: T9 — Volume bars add information, not stability
prompt: Volume bars dhidi ya calendar bars: zinatoa faida gani, kwa ushahidi wa mradi?

options.A: Information density zaidi (predictability∨context 18/18 dim×pair), SIO stability zaidi (stability 0/9). Information Density > Calendar Uniformity (F-007 vs R-002).
options.D: Faida ya net tradable edge moja kwa moja.

ground_truth: adaptive_volume_bar_report.md: stability 0/9 (volatility, activity). volume_information_report.md: information∨context 18/18; context-EV C→V −0.29→+0.50. Truth 9 (PROJECT_MEMORY §2, F-007 vs R-002).
rubric: FULL: information 18/18 SIO stability (0/9). ZERO: B (stability 9/9 — kinyume), C (hakuna faida), D (net tradable — information ni GROSS, si tradability).

prompt: Unajenga mfumo wa maamuzi juu ya edge. Ni fremu gani ya tatizo iliyo sahihi kwa mujibu wa mradi?

options.A: Classification ya kila trade (pass/fail) kwa threshold ya probability.
options.B: Kutabiri return halisi ya kila trade.
options.C: RANKING ya configurations na SELECTION (ranking > classification; selection > prediction; F-023/P21/P23); confidence ni valuable kama EV (F-024/CCS). Context = ranking engine, sio pass/fail.
options.D: Regression ya price moja kwa moja.

ground_truth: PROGRAM_BOARD F-008 (context = ranking engine, monotonic decile-EV, not pass/fail), F-023 (ranking; selection > prediction, P21/P23), F-024 (confidence valuable as EV, CCS). Truth 10 (PROJECT_MEMORY §2).
rubric: FULL: inachagua ranking/selection juu ya classification/prediction. ZERO: A (classification pass/fail), B/D (kutabiri return/price — selection>prediction inakanusha).

truth: T12 — Profitable ≠ Tradable; protect capital first
prompt: 'Protect capital first, seek edge second, scale only after proof.' Je, hii inamaanisha usifanye biashara KAMWE?

options.B: Hapana — inamaanisha MPANGILIO: linda mtaji → thibitisha edge (pre-registered OOS) → ndipo scale; Profitable ≠ Tradable (raw EV chanya au in-sample ≠ ruhusa ya kutrade). Si marufuku ya kutrade, ni gate ya ushahidi kabla ya scale.
options.D: Hapana — trade kwa ukubwa kamili mara edge chanya inapoonekana in-sample.

rubric: FULL: inaeleza mpangilio protect→prove→scale NA Profitable≠Tradable. ZERO: A/C (kutokutrade kamwe / hakuna edge itathibitishwa), D (scale kwa in-sample profit — inakanusha proof-before-scale).
